notes: DIRECT - PRUProtect Term: term, tpd and premium cells describe PRUProtect Term (5 or 20 years, or to age 65); PRUProtect Term 5 is the 5-year renewable variant. The term cell quotes Prudential's Direct Purchase factsheet (a general term-life DPI document). Maximum entry age is not stated in the brochure or page.

PRUActive Protect Series: pre-critical, recurring and relapse cover are optional supplementary benefits (Early Protect, Early Protect Plus, Protect Plus); the stages and conditions cells describe the base severe stage plans. Entry age and a waiting period after cover starts are not stated on the page or brochure (only a 12 or 24 month gap between repeat claims).

PRUActive Crisis Guard: pays on treatments (open surgery, organ transplant, cancer treatment, ICU) as well as three advanced stage critical illnesses. Maximum renewal age is 70 age next birthday and conversion to a whole life or endowment plan is allowed under age 55 (page footnotes 6 and 7). Entry age is not stated.

PRUEarly Stage Crisis Cover: the page states cancer cover from age 1 up till 100 only, not a policy term for all benefits; the brochure policy terms (45 and 35 years) are premium illustrations. Term and entry age are therefore left out.

PRULady and PRUMan: illness, procedure and surgery lists are given per benefit, not as one condition count, so conditions is left out. Both pages say cover runs up to before the policy anniversary preceding 65 or 75 years old (two options, not specified which applies to which plan type).

PRUExtra: pairs_with left out because no single contiguous Prudential sentence names all three plans against both tiers. Prudential's pages show Plus Care with PRUShield Plus, and Premier Care and Preferred Care with PRUShield Premier. For Preferred Care, co-insurance coverage does not apply at Non-Panel and No Access Providers (brochure footnote). The 75 age next birthday maximum entry age comes from the footnotes of the PRUExtra premium tables and applies to Singapore Citizens, PRs and Foreigners (Type 1 or 2). PRUExtra Premier/Plus Lite and CoPay variants are withdrawn.

PRUActive Term, PRUVital Cover, PRUMortgage: entry age not stated on the page or brochure. PRUActive Term and PRUMortgage premium guarantee is not stated for the main benefit (only that Crisis Care III premiums are not guaranteed, for PRUActive Term). PRUVital Cover term is not stated.
